# A logger offered you a price for your timber. Is it low?

> Free timber sale offer checker for landowners: enter your logs and a logger's offer, see board feet under Doyle, Scribner and International rules, the value at your own prices, and whether the offer looks low. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
